projects.title: Clarvo
projects.shortDescription: A focused exam-preparation mobile app for Cameroonian students with past papers, notes, planning, offline access and progress features.
projects.fullDescription: Clarvo is an exam-preparation product designed around the real study flow of GCE and HND learners: find the right paper, study useful notes, practise, plan revision, continue offline and track progress without clutter.
projects.problem: Students often jump between PDFs, chat groups, websites and notebooks just to prepare for one exam session.
projects.solution: A mobile-first study flow that groups past questions, answers, notes, downloads, planning and progress in one clear product.
projects.responsibilities: Product architecture, mobile frontend, navigation, data flow, offline strategy, build pipeline and product UX.
projects.challenges: Keeping the experience fast on affordable Android phones, handling offline content, and making a large exam catalogue easy to navigate.
projects.results: A production-oriented Expo codebase with real authentication, content flows, offline considerations, gamification and test APK distribution.
projects.metaDescription: A focused exam-preparation mobile app for Cameroonian students with past papers, notes, planning, offline access and progress features.

projects.title: Cameroon Zoom
projects.shortDescription: A Yelp-inspired business discovery platform adapted to Cameroon, with search, categories, ratings, maps and business profiles.
projects.fullDescription: Cameroon Zoom is a local business directory focused on making companies, services and useful places easier to discover in Cameroon. It combines structured business profiles, search, reviews, maps and owner-facing flows.
projects.problem: Local business information is fragmented across social networks, messaging apps and unstructured listings.
projects.solution: A searchable, map-aware directory with business profiles, categories, reviews, verification flows and clear discovery UX.
projects.responsibilities: Product design, frontend architecture, business data model, mapping, search, authentication and deployment.
projects.challenges: Normalizing inconsistent location data, designing trustworthy business pages and keeping map/search performance predictable.
projects.results: A working directory product with responsive web UX, business discovery, reviews and geolocation-oriented features.
projects.metaTitle: Cameroon Zoom — Software Engineering Case Study
projects.metaDescription: A Yelp-inspired business discovery platform adapted to Cameroon, with search, categories, ratings, maps and business profiles.

projects.title: Les Fleurs Invoice
projects.shortDescription: A modern invoice and business-management application built for real client workflows, document generation and payment links.
projects.fullDescription: A practical invoicing system built around day-to-day business operations: clients, invoices, PDF generation, online consultation, branding and reliable cloud-backed data access.
projects.problem: Small businesses need a faster way to create, share and follow professional invoices without heavyweight accounting software.
projects.solution: A focused dashboard with document generation, client records, branded invoices and shareable online views.
projects.responsibilities: Full-stack implementation, Firebase migration, access control, invoice generation, UX and deployment fixes.
projects.challenges: Maintaining consistent business data, reliable document rendering and secure server-side access checks.
projects.results: A client-oriented web application with production workflows rather than a demo-only CRUD interface.
projects.metaTitle: Les Fleurs Invoice — Software Engineering Case Study
projects.metaDescription: A modern invoice and business-management application built for real client workflows, document generation and payment links.

projects.title: QRcode Master
projects.shortDescription: A QR and barcode scanner built for quick scanning, history, gallery import, Wi‑Fi sharing and practical daily use.
projects.fullDescription: QRcode Master is a mobile utility focused on speed and clarity: scan, import, save history and share useful QR-based information with a persistent, mobile-native navigation model.
projects.problem: Many scanner apps are ad-heavy or bury simple scan/history flows under unnecessary UI.
projects.solution: A lightweight scanner experience with camera controls, gallery import, batch-friendly history and practical QR utilities.
projects.responsibilities: Mobile UI, camera integration, local history, navigation and Android build preparation.
projects.challenges: Camera permissions, low-light scanning, native dependencies and keeping APK size reasonable.
projects.results: A testable Android application prepared for development and shareable builds.
projects.metaTitle: QRcode Master — Software Engineering Case Study
projects.metaDescription: A QR and barcode scanner built for quick scanning, history, gallery import, Wi‑Fi sharing and practical daily use.

projects.title: Rush Smart File Organizer
projects.shortDescription: A desktop productivity tool for organizing files with a simple local-first workflow.
projects.fullDescription: Rush explores a focused desktop workflow for sorting and managing files locally, with the goal of reducing repetitive organization work without sending personal files to a cloud service.
projects.problem: Downloads and work folders quickly become noisy, making it harder to retrieve files and keep a clean workspace.
projects.solution: A local desktop organizer that helps classify and manage files with a straightforward interface.
projects.responsibilities: Product concept, desktop interface, local database and file-management logic.
projects.challenges: Safe file operations, cross-platform paths and predictable local state.
projects.results: Published as a public GitHub repository and used as an exploration of local-first desktop tooling.
